candidate_relations.reason: Gram-positive organisms from an iris abscess after dental cleaning are not lens-induced uveitis/glaucoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: lens-induced inflammation vs infectious iris abscess

candidate_relations.reason: There was no intraocular surgery; infection followed dental cleaning, so postoperative endophthalmitis conflicts in setting.
Iritis describes anterior-chamber cells/fibrin but omits endogenous endophthalmitis and iris abscess.
Blood and urine cultures were negative, so documented sepsis is not established; it is at most a related hematogenous hypothesis.
Uveitis is a parent inflammatory label without the required endogenous infection and iris abscess.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: uveitis parent missing infectious endophthalmitis and abscess

case_quality_flags: Iris abscess grew S. intermedius after dental cleaning; blood cultures negative and no vitritis, which is atypical for classic endophthalmitis.
